subject: Acme Procurement: next steps on commercial path and security gating
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reid <samantha.reid@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme discovery — procurement + security follow-ups

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on procurement and security gating: 

1) Commercial path: you mentioned Finance prefers PO for vendor onboarding (no corporate card). Can you confirm the PO flow (Sourcing team + AP) and who I should send the vendor packet to? If Acme is interested in marketplace purchase instead (AWS Marketplace), that can simplify procurement but requires a separate marketplace contract — is that something your team would consider?

2) Timing & SOW: For rollout planning we typically include an initial committed capacity period. If you can share the expected start date and approximate monthly usage, I’ll get a SOW draft & pricing over to you. I’ve added a DocuSign SOW link below for when terms are agreed.

3) Security/compliance gating: you flagged SOC 2 Type II and DPA as gating items. We can provide a copy of our SOC 2 Type II (redacted) under NDA and a downloadable DPA. I’m attaching a DPA stub and our latest security questionnaire responses we’ve prepared (we’ll continue to iterate these with your vendor-risk team). 

4) Next meeting: propose a 30-min call next week with Acme Sourcing + Legal and our Legal + Vivek (SE) to walk through the DPA, SOC2 sharing timeline, and any outstanding questionnaire items.

Action items: 
- Samantha: confirm PO contact (name + email) and whether marketplace is an option
- Acme legal/vendor-risk: confirm any additional evidence needed (network diagrams, encryption attestations, audit logs retention)
- Marissa: send SOW template & DPA stub (attached); coordinate SOC 2 share under NDA

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Acme_signed_stub.pdf (stub), Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_responses_v1.xlsx

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ACME
DocuSign (SOW): https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-REDWOOD-SOW

Thanks — talk soon.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

From: Samantha Reid <samantha.reid@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme discovery — procurement + security follow-ups

Hi Marissa — great summary, thanks. A few answers from my side: 

- Procurement path: correct — we do PO via Sourcing/AP. Please send the vendor onboarding packet to Tom Hughes (Sourcing) at tom.hughes@acme.com. He owns contracts for 3rd-party SaaS. We will not be using a corporate card for this purchase.

- Marketplace: we are open to AWS Marketplace if pricing and terms look equivalent; however our Procurement team typically prefers direct PO unless a marketplace purchase simplifies approvals. Open to evaluating both.

- Security gating: our vendor-risk team requires a SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is okay) and a signed DPA. They also often ask for completed security questionnaire responses (we can run it through our vendor-risk portal). 

- Timeline: Targeting a decision by end of October for an early November start if procurement moves smoothly.

Please send the DPA & SOW. I’ll loop Tom and our vendor-risk contact if needed. Tom — I added Marissa from Redwood; can you confirm next steps on paperwork?

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Reid
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
samantha.reid@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reid <samantha.reid@acme.com>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@acme.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme discovery — procurement + security follow-ups

Thanks Samantha — adding Tom here. Tom, good to meet you — I’ve attached a DPA stub for initial review and a completed security questionnaire (v1) that covers the typical vendor-risk ask. A few notes: 

- SOC 2: We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report under a mutual NDA or via a secure portal. If Acme prefers, we can arrange a bridging NDA now and provide the report within 3 business days after NDA execution.

- Marketplace vs PO: I’ll prepare two clean options — (A) PO/vendor onboarding packet + SOW, and (B) AWS Marketplace listing info & invoice flow. If Marketplace is acceptable to your legal/procurement, it often reduces paperwork and speeds procurement.

- Billing contact: who should we invoice (bill-to email) for the vendor packet? If you can confirm, I’ll populate the SOW and vendor form.

Proposed next step: 30-min legal + procurement sync next Wed 09/29 or Thu 09/30. Vivek and I will join to cover technical questions and SOC 2 evidence needs. 

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Acme_signed_stub.pdf, Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_responses_v1.xlsx

—Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reid <samantha.reid@acme.com>, Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme discovery — procurement + security follow-ups

Hi Samantha / Tom — quick note from SE side on the evidence we typically provide for vendor-risk reviews so you can share the list with your team: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) — available under NDA
- DPA — copy attached (Marissa included)
- Encryption: TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest (we can provide KMS integration details)
- Network diagrams & architecture PDF (I can provide a templated diagram)
- Logging & retention: access logs and audit trails retained for 90 days by default; extended retention options available
- Data residency & deployment options: hosted (Redwood-hosted), Dedicated (customer-dedicated GPU pool), Private (VPC/on-prem) — we can include deployment-specific controls per your requirement

If helpful, I’m happy to join the procurement/legal sync next week and walk the vendor-risk team through each item.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
